Abhijeet Dipke questions PM Modi on FIRs, CJP's future

Abhijeet Dipke questioned Prime Minister Narendra Modi regarding FIRs and the future of the organisation CJP. The coverage highlights Dipke's direct address to the Prime Minister, posing a question about whether cases would be withdrawn. This interaction occurred in the context of government assurances and ongoing legal actions.
